Indian Standard
SPECIFICATION FOR SOLVENT-EXTRACTED COCONUT OlLCAKE ( MEAL) AS LIVESTOCK FEED INGREDIENT

( Second Revision)
o.
FOR E WO R D

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Second Revision) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 31 December 1985, after the draft finalized by the Animal Feeds Sectional Committee had been approved by the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council.

0.2 In order to encourage the use of solvent-extracted oilcakes ( meals)
for feeding the livestock and at the same time to ensure the extracted meals to be free from toxic hazards, it was keenly felt by the Ministry of Health that national standards be formulated to control the quality of the solvent-extracted oilcakes ( meals ). 0.3 This standard was fisrt published in 1966 and revised in 1968. The Committee in the present revision took note of the latest developments in the manufacturing, trading, storing and consumption pattern of the product. Accordingly the requirements are being modified. Opportunity is also being taken to give reference to IS : 7874 ( Part 1 )-1975* (or the sake of uniformity in test methods.

0.4 Inclusion of the aflatoxin limit in the standard did not find favour with the Committee at this stage because of the non-availability of a reliable and quick method for its determination. Further, data for fixing a safe limit in the product meant for livestock feed was also not available. However, it was a considered view of the committee for fixing this limit as early as possible.
0.5 In the preparation of this standard due consideration has been given to the provision of the solvent extraction orders. However, this standard is subject to the restriction imposed under these, wherever applicable.
� Me thods of test for a nimal feeds and feeding stuffs: Part 1 General methods.

1. SCOPE
1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for solvent-extracted coconut oilcake (meal) used as livestock feed ingredient.

2. REQ,UIREMENTS
2.1 De8criptioD - The material shall be in the form of either flakes or powder. It shall be free from harmful constituents. It shall be free from rancidity, adulterants, insect or visible fungus infestation and from musty odour. The material shall be free from harmful constituents. It shall also be free from dirt and other extraneous matter including metallic pieces. 2.2 Solvent for EztractloD - Only hexane of food grade conforming to IS : 3470�1966* shall be used for extracting coconut oilcake, 2.3 The material shall also conform to the requirements prescribed in Table 1.

3. PACKING AND MARKING

3.1 PacklD. - Unless otherwise agreed to between the purchaser and the vendor. the material shall be packed in clean and sound jute bags or HDPE bags and securely closed�

3.2 MarklD. - Each bag shall be indelibly and legibly marked to give the following information: a) b) c) d) e) Name of the material; Name of the manufacturer; Batch or code number; Net mass in kg, when packed; and Date of packing.

f. SAMPLING

4.1 The method of drawing representative samples of the material for
tests and the criteria for conformity shall be as prescribed in Appendix C of IS : 2052�1979-.

NOTE - 'Pure chemicals' shall mean chemicals that do not contain impurities which affect the results of analysis.
